pack.name: Water & Food
pack.attribution: CDC, EPA and USDA water, canning and food-storage guidance

_notes: Every url below was fetched on 2026-11-09 and returned 2xx with Content-Type application/pdf and a %PDF- magic header. 'verified' records that check, not a licence review.

www.cdc.gov sits behind Akamai, which refuses non-browser clients by TLS fingerprint from some networks: plain urllib and curl get 403 Access Denied even with a full browser header set. The CDC entry below may therefore fail to download from CI. If it does, the options are a GovInfo or archive mirror, or vendoring the PDF into this repo with its sha256 recorded. Flagged as an open question in the repo README.

Do NOT use https://www.cdc.gov/healthywater/emergency/pdf/make-water-safe-during-emergency-p.pdf : it answers 200 with text/html (it redirects into a web page despite the .pdf extension) and would put an HTML error page into the pack.

USDA's Complete Guide to Home Canning has no merged single-file PDF on any official host. It is published as eight files, all listed here. They are hosted on nchfp.uga.edu (a NIFA-funded centre at the University of Georgia), not on a .gov domain; the underlying USDA bulletin is still a US Government work.
